summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K on 28 September 2026 attaching a press release updating its share buy-back program launched 30 October 2025. The Leuven-based 3D printing company reported repurchasing 31,306 ordinary shares/ADSs during 21-25 September 2026 at an average price of EUR 6.99 per share, for EUR 218,945, all through the NASDAQ central order book; no block or cross trades occurred. Since the program's 26 January 2026 start, Materialise has bought back 1,386,527 shares for EUR 7,177,921, equal to approximately 2.3% of shares outstanding. A discretionary mandate of up to EUR 30 million is granted to an independent intermediary. Watch execution pace versus the authorization ceiling and any EPS accretion or overhang dynamics.
